content.text: In regions where platforms like Stripe and PayPal are unavailable, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/digital-product-stores-kyc-payments-every-detail-you-9|Digital Product]] [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-creator-built-payment-solutions-zimbabwean-digital-sellers-3|COREMERCH guide to creator]]s face insurmountable challenges. This guide outlines how to deploy a digital store on Cloudflare Pages, bypassing conventional payment barriers. By using COREMERCH's infrastructure, you can launch your store swiftly and effectively without needing traditional payment methods. This is essential for creators in countries like Nigeria, Ghana, and Venezuela, where [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/financial-sovereignty-digital-creators-crypto-honest-side-side-28|financial]] access is limited. Prepare to take control of your digital commerce today.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Current financial structures often exclude creators in various regions, leaving them without the means to sell their digital products. COREMERCH addresses this gap by providing a robust infrastructure that enables full ownership of digital commerce. Unlike conventional platforms, this approach leverages open-source tools and blockchain technology, ensuring that your store remains operational regardless of external financial restrictions. By deploying a system based on Cloudflare Pages, you gain access to a reliable setup that circumvents the limitations of traditional payment systems.
What You Need Before You Deploy

To successfully deploy your digital store on Cloudflare Pages, gather the necessary components first. You will need a GitHub account for hosting your site, access to Cloudflare for DNS management, and Google Apps Script for backend processing logic. Additionally, create a NOWPayments account to handle crypto transactions seamlessly. Familiarize yourself with the Sovereign Blueprint, which will guide you through the deployment process effectively. Collect your digital products, ensuring they are prepared for upload, and choose the cryptocurrencies you wish to support, allowing you to cater to your audience.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by configuring your payment and delivery pipeline to ensure a smooth customer experience. Set up your NOWPayments integration to accept various cryptocurrencies while minimizing transaction fees. This allows you to cater to a global audience without the constraints of conventional payment processes. Next, use Google Apps Script to automate order management and file delivery. This script will connect your payment processor with your order storage solution, such as Google Sheets, enabling seamless fulfillment of digital products. Testing this pipeline thoroughly before going live ensures that all components work together flawlessly.
Own your digital commerce infrastructure; don’t rent it.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is in place, it’s time to launch. Deploy your site on Cloudflare Pages and ensure all configurations are optimized. Use the provided documentation from COREMERCH to verify that your NOWPayments integration is functioning correctly. Promote your store to your audience, directing them to your newly established platform. When a customer places an order, monitor the transaction through NOWPayments to confirm successful payment verification. This moment is crucial, as it represents the culmination of your efforts to establish a sovereign digital commerce presence.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

As your digital store begins to gain traction, consider strategies for scaling your operations. Use analytics to track sales trends and customer behavior, allowing you to refine your offerings accordingly. You can expand your product line beyond the initial five products loaded during setup by leveraging the Edge Commerce Stack for a more robust solution. This additional infrastructure layer supports enhanced features and capabilities, including automated email marketing configurations with SPF, DKIM, and DMARC. Ensure that your scaling efforts maintain the sovereignty and ownership of your digital store.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

The setup sequence matters because each component depends on the previous one being correctly configured. Start with NOWPayments: create your account, configure wallet addresses for each coin you want to accept, generate the API key, and note the IPN secret key you will set. Then configure the backend: in Stack 01, deploy the Google Apps Script Web App and note its URL; in Stack 02, deploy the Cloudflare Worker and note its URL. Set that URL as the webhook endpoint in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Then configure the storefront. Then run a real mainnet test — send actual crypto to your configured wallet address, confirm NOWPayments detects it, confirm the webhook fires, and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link.
Leverage crypto payments to bypass conventional barriers.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Creators at the store setup stage comparing Stack 01 and Stack 02 are typically choosing between building it themselves with the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 — which covers both stacks in complete detail with full source code — or having COREMERCH deploy the complete Edge Stack under their accounts with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Both result in the same ownership structure: your GitHub or Cloudflare account, your Supabase database, your NOWPayments account, your wallet, your store. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Follow the setup sequence without skipping steps — configuration errors are significantly harder to diagnose than setup time. First: create your NOWPayments account, add wallet addresses, generate your API key, and note your IPN secret key. Second: deploy the backend — configure Cloudflare Worker with your NOWPayments credentials and product settings, or configure Google Apps Script with the same — and confirm the endpoint URL. Third: set the webhook endpoint URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Fourth: deploy the storefront to Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages and confirm product pages and checkout display correctly. Fifth: configure your custom domain and DNS if using one. Sixth: complete a real mainnet test transaction. Seventh: check the order database for the test entry. Only after steps six and seven pass cleanly should you share the store URL publicly.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

Use Cloudflare Pages for free hosting and integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. This allows you to create a fully functional digital store without incurring hosting fees or traditional payment barriers.
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?

Stack 01 utilizes GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script for a quick setup, taking 4-6 hours. Stack 02, or the Edge Commerce Stack, uses Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase, deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours, with enhanced features and testing.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?

Yes, both platforms offer free hosting for digital stores. GitHub Pages is suitable for simpler setups, while Cloudflare Pages provides more advanced capabilities, especially when paired with backend solutions.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept with NOWPayments?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to cater to a diverse customer base. This flexibility ensures you can accept payments in popular coins relevant to your audience.
How can I ensure my digital store is secure?

Implement SSL through Cloudflare, use secure payment methods with NOWPayments, and regularly update your backend scripts. These steps ensure your customers’ data remains protected and your transactions are secure.
